digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflow for pytest on macOS
propositions: The macOS critical path pytest suite has a 20+ minute wall time dominated by Git-heavy filesystem operations to thousands of temporary stores.

An APFS RAM disk experiment was implemented following OSS precedent (Apple Git CI, Aeron) and measured to determine if storage placement on RAM improves Verify job and default/integration tier wall times.

Measured treatment runs (31869753711, 31869919362, 31870391571, 31873067707) all executed slower than the no-RAM control (31868300174): default suite ranged 18m26s–20m54s versus control 17m26s, failing the ≥5% improvement retention oracle.

Snapshot fixture cleanup exposed two defects: owner-nonwritable workflow snapshot trees caused recursive rm -rf to raise PermissionError, and nested pytest inherited outer cacheprovider settings causing REPO_ROOT leaks.

The storage hypothesis was rejected and the RAM-disk lifecycle (setup, reporting, recursive release, detach) was reverted; both default and integration pytest tiers restored to runner.temp with distinct basetemps.

No changes were made to pytest selectors, markers, xdist worker counts, timeouts, Python/platform matrix cells, coverage behavior, or test assertions; only storage placement and its observability were experimental.
